V-M-BUN-VERSION-GUARD.Scenario: A Bun at or above the engines.bun minimum is accepted, including later canaries such as 1.4.5-canary.1.
A Bun below the minimum, such as 1.4.3, is rejected.
V-M-BUN-VERSION-GUARD.TraceAssertion: The isSupported table test passes for every row of the version-guard contract.

V-M-REVIEW-GATE.Scenario: A failing check step becomes a JUnit test case with a failure, so the review gate sees it as a new failure.
bun test's own suites are kept in the same report under one testsuites root.
The report stays well-formed when step output or bun test's JUnit contains escape codes.
A failure message picks the first real error line, not bun's wrapper line or the summary.
V-M-REVIEW-GATE.TraceAssertion: The buildReport, escapeXml, sanitizeText and failureMessage unit tests pass.
